description: One record per item pptx.gallery shows or the OPF catalogs define (every catalog record, every gallery page item, every font tracker family, every slide-size preset and the gallery's coming teasers), with lifecycle columns from the committed measurements, a status and whether its gaps are addressed. Internal tracking only; never shown on a site.

parity.note: The latest committed parity run (RR-20 re-audit): the published 0.12 set (core 0.12.0, opf-render 0.12.0, opf-pptx 0.12.2, opf-editor 0.11.1) on pptx-gallery c349a61, with the RR-44 classifier for computed value-axis tick labels. It replaces the RR-16 candidate run (741 perfect, 109 near, 0 mismatch) and the published-package run before it (739 / 111 / 0); no value regressed.

nativeEvidence.rule: json and md files under a path segment naming native or PowerPoint; a value counts as exercised when such a file names it

done.meaning: Every column passes: in the spec or catalog, composes, previews, exports and re-imports, parity perfect, switchable in the editor, shown on pptx.gallery, its fonts accepted, and a committed native PowerPoint evidence run names it.

deprecated.meaning: A catalog record deprecated in favour of another id (its `deprecation.replacedBy`); kept so documents resolve, not shown on pptx.gallery and not measured by decision.

descoped.meaning: Every remaining gap is descoped by a decision, with an issue that states the current behaviour, what full support needs and the evidence.

works-unverified.meaning: Every automated column passes, but no committed native PowerPoint evidence run names this value.

unknown.meaning: A column has no data source for this record (no audit, parity or probe measured it), so it is not known to work.

parity-near.meaning: The preview and the PPTX agree only within the near tolerance on at least one parity check (latest parity run).

font-gap.meaning: A font the value draws is not accepted in the font tracker (accepted means status qualified or documented-visual).

missing-gallery.meaning: Not shown on pptx.gallery: served only as catalog JSON, announced as coming, or without its card preview.

missing-spec.meaning: Not in the bundled core catalog: published only by the pptx.gallery catalog, or not published in any catalog.

missing-editor.meaning: The editor has no switch operation for this kind of value (FF-16, RR-06).

parity-mismatch.meaning: The preview and the PPTX disagree beyond the near tolerance on at least one parity check.

native-mismatch.meaning: Desktop PowerPoint reads the value differently from the exported file: a gated check of the RR-42 native run fails (opened, fonts, theme slots or colours, Presentation.Fonts, shape count or geometry, background, pictures, header/footer placeholders, fields, charts, notes or tags).

missing-export.meaning: The PPTX export fails, is not native, or does not re-import to the same value.

missing-preview.meaning: The preview fails or does not change for this value.

broken.meaning: The value does not validate or compose in core.

nextActionDefinition: A gap's next action is its own `next` (derived, for example the font tracker's next action for the family), else the `next` of the rule it names in `rules`, else `defaultNext` for its code.

world-parked.next: Parked for post-v1 by the owner (2026-10-01): the export stays on the clustered column fallback with a chart-data-adapted diagnostic; an offline native map export is the future work.

world-parked-parity.next: Follows the parked export: the fallback column chart re-imports as column.

font-routes-near.next: A visual look-alike route, intended by the owner decision of 2026-09-29 (the PPTX keeps the selected family); the font tracker carries the family's remaining work (FF-44, FF-46 native verification).

font-tracker-gaps.next: The font tracker's next action for the family (RR-17 font long tail: script corpora, native verification FF-46).

legacy-font-pairings.next: Decided (RR-41, 2026-10-02): publish the four legacy pairings gallery-first as schema-valid font schemes with app "Google Slides" (additive; retiring them would remove public pages), then sync and release core; tracked in opf#317.

slide-size-pages.next: A pptx.gallery aspect-ratio page with a card per preset.

motion-deferred.next: Navigation and motion are deferred out of v1 by the owner (2026-10-01).

defaultNext.works-unverified: Include the value in a native PowerPoint sample (supervisor-run) and commit the evidence under docs/evidence.
defaultNext.unknown: Measure the missing columns (audit or probe) and commit the result.
defaultNext.parity-near: Find the cause of the near check and fix the engine or the harness, then re-run parity.
defaultNext.font-gap: Finish the font tracker's next action for the family.
defaultNext.missing-gallery: Give the value a gallery page and card, or record that it stays catalog-only.
defaultNext.missing-spec: Publish the value in the core catalog, or record that it stays gallery-only.
defaultNext.missing-editor: Add an editor switch for the value, or record that the editor does not switch it.
defaultNext.parity-mismatch: Fix the preview or the export so parity reaches near or perfect.
defaultNext.native-mismatch: Find why PowerPoint reads the value differently (the failing check and its detail are in the native run's values.json), fix the export, and re-run the deck natively.
defaultNext.missing-export: Fix the export or the re-import.
defaultNext.broken: Fix the value so it validates and composes.

columns.spec: catalog (bundled in core spec/catalogs), catalog-deprecated, gallery-catalog (published by the pptx.gallery catalog only), schema (a gallery item that maps to an OPF schema value), schema-enum (slide-size presets), policy (font policy), none.
columns.compose: pass or fail: the gallery config validates and composes in core (audit A schema check; audit B schema and catalog checks). unknown when no audit measured the value. The catalog-only records and the slide-size presets come from the later audit B run in inputs.auditBExtra (RR-43: a gallery snippet of the same kind with only the value swapped).
columns.preview: pass or fail: the renderer draws the value and it changes the preview (audit A render check; audit B host-font preview). For fonts: the preview face is bundled.
columns.export: pass or fail: opf-pptx exports the value natively (audit A export check; audit B export, and the native chart construct for charts). For fonts: the PPTX keeps the selected family name.
columns.roundTrip: pass or fail: the export re-imports to the same value (audit A re-import check; audit B has no re-import reason and charts re-import as the same type).
columns.parity: perfect, near or mismatch: the worst variant of the value in the latest parity run (inputs.parity); unmeasured when the run has no config for it. The catalog-only records and the slide-size presets come from the later run in inputs.parityExtra (RR-43).
columns.editor: switch when opf-editor's switch operation covers the dimension (SWITCH_DIMENSIONS, FF-16 and RR-06; one tested case per dimension in test/switches.mjs, values offered from the bundled catalog); none otherwise.
columns.gallery: shown (page and card), shown-no-preview, json-only (served only as catalog JSON), not-shown, not-shown-deprecated, coming (pptx.gallery home teaser).
columns.native: verified or failed when the RR-42 native run (inputs.nativeRuns: per-value verdicts of the gated checks) covers the value; else exercised when a committed native PowerPoint evidence run names the value (inputs.evidence, rule in inputs.nativeEvidence), or unverified. For fonts: the font tracker native verification.
columns.fonts: accepted when every family the value draws (its parity fontResolution families, else its catalog font scheme) is qualified or documented-visual in the font tracker; gap otherwise; n/a when it draws no chosen family. For fonts: the font tracker status.

addressedDefinition: A record is addressed when it is done or deprecated, or when every gap is linked to an open RR item (todo, in-progress or review) or a pull request, or is descoped with an issue. A gap linked to a closed RR item is not addressed: the item claims a fix the measurement does not show yet (re-audit or reopen).
